user.title: CUKTECH Charger
user.description: Set up your CUKTECH charger. This integration uses MQTT to receive real-time data from the CUKTECH BLE server.

data_description.topic_prefix: Leave empty for the default cuktech/charger. If the server advertises its devices, the prefix reported by the server is used instead.

device.title: Select Charger
device.description: The server reports several chargers. Each charger is added as its own entry.

reauth.title: Reauthenticate
reauth.description: The connection details of the CUKTECH BLE server have changed. Please re-enter them.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The connection details of the CUKTECH BLE server have changed. Please verify and re-enter them.

error.device_not_found: The selected charger is no longer reported by the server

init.title: CUKTECH Charger options
init.description: Change the entry's MQTT namespace and its label. The entry is reloaded after saving.

data_description.name: This is the label of the integration card / hub node — not the charger's own name. The device name follows the server automatically (unless you renamed the device in Home Assistant, which takes precedence). Renaming here pins the label so auto-sync stops changing it; clear this field and save to hand it back to auto-sync.
data_description.server_url: The ble_server (or ESP32) this entry talks to.
data_description.topic_prefix: Topics this entry subscribes to and publishes on. Empty = cuktech/charger.
data_description.device_id: Leave empty when the server has no per-device addressing (ESP32, old server).
